page.overview:
Who is Child?

His mother, an Old Woman of Darunia, implores Link to rescue her Child who was taken to Maze Island. The Child is guarded by an orange Geru in a on the southeast corner of the Island. Rescuing and taking back the Child to the Old Woman rewards Link with meeting an Old Man who teaches him the Reflect Magic.

In the Japanese version, he is bound in ropes due to the way Link picks up items (you have to stab to pick it up). Therefore, stabbing is more like cutting the rope off him
